text:
Jordan M: Hi team — my corporate card was declined at the hotel last night in NYC, I paid $342.12 on my personal card. Can I get reimbursed? Receipt attached (hotel-nyc-0306.pdf).
finance-bot: Hi Jordan — please submit via expenses portal and choose expense_type: travel.lodging. Include guest list if applicable. Note: corporate card declines are reimbursable but finance may request a card dispute record if decline was avoidable.
Jordan M: Submitted now (claim 1806129999-1). I added a short note: card declined despite being active.
Priya (Travel Ops): Sorry about that. If card decline was due to hold or vendor auth, send me the hotel folio and card decline timestamp and I can open a ticket with the card provider. For immediate reimbursement this looks fine.
Samira F: Quick flag — please confirm you used the approved per-night rate policy. If rate is above guide, we will need pre-approval or justification.
Jordan M: Rate was $171.06/night, within policy. Folio included in the upload.
finance-bot: Status: submitted -> pending-manager-approval. ETA: AP run Wednesday. Payment method: ACH to bank on file (3-5 business days after run).
Jordan M: Thanks all. I'll DM Priya the auth timestamps for the dispute.
